question: What is the median days-to-fix by neighborhood?
text: The median days-to-fix for reported issues varies by neighborhood, ranging from 10 to 12 days. Most neighborhoods, including Mifflin, Langdon, Marquette, Southwest, Eken Park, Greenbush, and Regent, have a median of 11 days. The lowest median is 10 days (Vilas, Allied Drive), while the highest is 12 days (Tenney-Lapham, Bay Creek, Emerson East).
sql:
SELECT p.`neighborhood`, percentile_approx(DATEDIFF(r.`fixed_at`, r.`reported_at`), 0.5) AS median_days_to_fix
FROM `fixit`.`gold`.`reports` r
JOIN `fixit`.`gold`.`properties` p ON r.`property_id` = p.`property_id`
WHERE r.`fixed_at` IS NOT NULL
  AND p.`neighborhood` IS NOT NULL
  AND r.`reported_at` IS NOT NULL
  AND r.`fixed_at` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.`neighborhood`
